# rust-daq

> Modular, high-performance Rust data-acquisition system: headless gRPC daemon
> owning hardware + egui / WASM operator UI + Rhai scripting + Bluesky-style
> orchestration (`Plan` + `RunEngine`) + zero-copy frame pipeline
> (mmap ring buffer → HDF5 / Arrow / Zarr). 30-crate workspace, Rust 1.92.0.

This file is an `llms.txt` per <https://llmstxt.org>. Start with the wiki; fall
back to the Diataxis docs; read the code only when the wiki is silent.

## LLM Wiki (start here)

- [Wiki index](llm-wiki/index.md): catalog of all LLM-facing pages
- [Wiki schema & workflows](llm-wiki/schema.md): ingest / query / lint conventions

- [Crate index](llm-wiki/crates/index.md): one page per workspace member

## Core concepts

- [`Parameter<T>`](llm-wiki/concepts/parameter.md): reactive hardware state primitive
- [`Plan` + `RunEngine`](llm-wiki/concepts/plan-run-engine.md): Bluesky-style orchestration
- [Capability traits](llm-wiki/concepts/capability-traits.md): 30 composable device capabilities
- [`driver-universal`](llm-wiki/concepts/driver-universal.md): TOML-manifest forward path
- [`driver-registry`](llm-wiki/concepts/driver-registry.md): factory registration + feature gating
- [Ring buffer](llm-wiki/concepts/ring-buffer.md): mmap + seqlock + Arrow IPC
- [Mock registry](llm-wiki/concepts/mock-registry.md): deterministic test hardware
